|errata_history=This is the original printed state of the card, titled •The Emperor's Reach. The later version [[Maarek Stele, The Emperor's Reach (Virtual Block 6)]] (PC-E1, the current card) is titled •Maarek Stele, The Emperor's Reach. The release-sheet slip on this page prints •The Emperor's Reach; the Master List slip and the Players Committee card image print •Maarek Stele, The Emperor's Reach (see [[Maarek Stele, The Emperor's Reach (Virtual Block 6)]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): titled “•The Emperor's Reach” (lore “Leader.”) on the Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet, slip 3•08: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Once per game, may ▲ a TIE Defender. While piloting, opponent may not cancel or substitute battle destiny draws here. While piloting an Imperial starfighter, it is maneuver +2 and he draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of March 15, 2010"; PDF dated 4 April 2010), page 2, slip 308. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022213441/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-08-Maarek_Stele_The_Emperors_Reach.png]]) prints it. The PC website card list still showed the card under this title from 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013.<ref name="cl-1263_7-old">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive; the same in the VMasterType list): “The Emperor's Reach”</ref> The Virtual Block 6.3 sheet came out on 12 March 2010, three days before the date it carries<ref name="pc-6_3-release">Players Committee home page, news “Virtual Block 6.3: Mercenaries – Released!”, posted 4:40pm Friday, 12 March 2010, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20100409002355/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ 9 April 2010] (Internet Archive); the Players Committee Twitter account wrote on 13 March 2010 that the set “has been released early!” ([https://web.archive.org/web/20100721144451/http://twitter.com/swccg Internet Archive copy])</ref>.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Maarek Stele, The Emperor's Reach (Virtual Block 6)]]): On 29 January 2013 the [[Players Committee]] announced the persona-name change “The Emperor’s Reach ---> Maarek Stele”, effective immediately (old slips stayed tournament-legal; non-gameplay lore was removed; “Each of the cards will retain their gametext and characteristics”)<ref name="persona2013">[https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 New Persona Changes], [[Players Committee]], 29 January 2013. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive].</ref>. The PC website card list shows the new title by 13 March 2013 (the last capture with the old title is of 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-1263_7-new">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20130313220753/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-03-13] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130426080051/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-04-26] (Internet Archive): “Maarek Stele, The Emperor's Reach” (these captures carry no game text)</ref>, and the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 11) prints the card as “•Maarek Stele, The Emperor's Reach” (lore “Leader.”)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=11, page 11. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=11 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Once per game may ▲ a TIE Defender. While piloting, opponent may not cancel or substitute battle destiny draws here. While piloting an Imperial starfighter, it is maneuver +2 and he draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise.” The Master List also drops the comma after “Once per game” (punctuation only); the PC website card list (2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11, titled “The Emperor's Reach”) writes the pilot icon and the ▲ out (“may take a TIE Defender into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”). The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1263-7-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-maareksteletheemperorsreach-pre.gif]]) print it.
